scope: All regular root files in templates/local-automation-runtime plus nine explicitly selected operator/interface scripts. Recursive tests/examples/config/team-templates are dependencies or fixtures, not silently discarded executable roots. Imported modules with __main__ are wrapper aliases.
completeness: Every root regular file has a disposition and SHA256. Each supported entrypoint lists native argparse subcommands or explicit effect-bearing modes. Literal parser tokens are statically extracted; dynamically generated flags and combinations need implementation contract review. No scripts were executed. This is an entrypoint/mode inventory, not proof of exhaustive flag-combination semantics.
stage_note: Remaining lane order is descriptive only; user authorized daily first and all maintained scope, not this document as dispatch policy.
